experiment: FTREP: independent LE replicate of FT PR79 frozen v4 center-4 at L=2 Q=2048

ft_source.recipe: v4 center4 four equal SPSA blocks, frozen gains. v7/v8 used this exact recipe at L=2 Q=2048.

hypothesis.one_sentence: If FT's N15/N18 L2 Nov3 energy edge is recipe-real, the same frozen v4 center-4 equal-block SPSA on LE seeds 10152-10159 yields Nov3−QAOA mean ΔE CIs entirely below 0 at both N=15 and N=12.
hypothesis.not: Not a new schedule. Not S1JOINT. Not warm-start. Not FT holdout 10144-10151. Not a GR patch.

frozen_recipe.Q: Q=qL with q=1024, L=2 => Q=2048. Four equal blocks. T=Q/8-6=250.
frozen_recipe.per_start: 1 init + 8 calibration + 2T iteration + 3 candidates = 512. Four starts = 2048.
frozen_recipe.gains: c=0.1, A=25, exponents 0.602/0.101, a0=0.5/median(|g|/σ) or 0 if median<1e-15, clip 2σ, Rademacher ±1. Frozen, not live LE C0.
frozen_recipe.sigma: Nov3 γ 0.10, θ 0.25, shells 0.15; QAOA angles 0.10

starts.QAOA_0: every layer (γ,β)=(0.25,0.25), interleaved then mapped to LE stacked at energy time
starts.starts_1_3: Nov3 γ,θ ~ U(-0.5,0.5), shells ~ U(-0.3,0.3); QAOA angles ~ U(-0.5,0.5). Method ids 1 Nov3 / 0 QAOA. Init stream 2, SPSA stream 0. B* enters SeedSequence as round(10*B*).

frozen_recipe.selection: Lowest energy among init, last, Polyak min(64,T), midpoint. Energy tie keeps init. Across starts lower start_id wins. F post hoc.
frozen_recipe.qaoa_layout: FT stores interleaved [γ0,β0,...]. LE energy uses stacked [γ...,β...]. Conversion only at the energy call. SPSA stays in FT coordinates.

seeds.collision_check: no instance/run filenames; local≤10143 unused; LE≤10135; FT holdout 10144-10151 untouched; FT train 10018-25 unused; DEPTH S1W 10128-35; STARTS ≤10111; validation 11000-11031; final 20000-20999

selection: FT energy selection as above. F post hoc, never selects.

gate.R1: N15 L2 Q=2048, mean(E_Nov3 - E_QAOA) bootstrap 95% CI entirely below 0
gate.bootstrap: 4000 resamples, default_rng(3334), seeds resampled. Matches FT v7.
gate.pass: label FT-L2 REPLICATED on LE only if BOTH R1 and R2 pass
gate.otherwise: FAIL. Do not retune. Do not patch GR. Do not touch FT holdout.
gate.gr: Do not patch GR even if both pass.
